role: offline causal dispatch reconstruction and instruction-only energy diagnostic; no method comparison
registration_context: unit identity, empty Contego sample, Pillswood counts and overlapping instructions inspected; energy envelope not yet computed

asset.name: public two-hour reference battery
asset.capacity_basis: published Jamesfield site is 49 MW/98 MWh; Pillswood site is 98 MW/196 MWh
asset.asset_scope: reference asset with recorded unit workload; 98 MWh is not a measured E_PILLB-1 energy capacity

task: inventory planning for a reference battery subject to recorded dispatcher power requests

data.prior_context: previous day retained to cover instructions crossing the start boundary
data.period_scope: fixed candidates for the next development pilot, not completed archives or an independent comparison registration

instruction_semantics.levels: absolute export-positive MW from zero import/export; linear interpolation inside each published segment
instruction_semantics.visibility: participant receives the instruction at acceptanceTime; this is not the public API publication time
instruction_semantics.revision: latest received covering acceptance by acceptanceTime then acceptanceNumber replaces older absolute levels
instruction_semantics.intervals: UTC half-open intervals; preserve minute-scale changes and integrate import/export separately
instruction_semantics.gaps: no active recorded BOA; actual plant power is unknown here, not inferred to be zero
instruction_semantics.basis_scope: Elexon definitions and legacy settlement description establish absolute levels, interpolation and successive acceptance changes; this diagnostic is not a settlement calculator

information_contract.national_forecast: candidate predictor when publishTime is no later than the decision; national forecast errors are not dispatched to this plant
information_contract.planned_instruction: future points in an already received acceptance may be observed; later acceptances may not be observed
information_contract.historical_PN_MEL_MIL: ex-post reference only until a publication-vintage archive is established; dynamic limits are not fixed hardware limits
information_contract.realized_prices: ex-post accounting only; not advance policy inputs

diagnostic.energy_envelope: assume idle only in BOA gaps for this instruction-only calculation; find initial inventories that could follow all requests without additional replenishment
diagnostic.initial_inventory: report feasible interval and the common 50 percent reference; historical initial inventory is not estimated
diagnostic.criterion: energy remains in [0,98] MWh and absolute requested power is at most 49 MW
diagnostic.legacy_unserved_fraction_0_11: not used; not a published BM service requirement
diagnostic.readiness_use: identify whether replenishment is necessary; no policy certification, profit or deployment claim

next_model_work: define a causal replenishment action, energy-purchase timing and terminal inventory valuation before running candidate-library feasibility or optimizer comparisons
